subject.title: chore(deps): bump the production-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 5 updates

question: Should this five-package production update remain grouped after the failed local-auth and Vercel checks, or should it be split to isolate compatibility and deployment risk?
rationale: The diff has no definite implementation bug, but CI does not establish whether the runtime failures are flaky, base-branch failures, or regressions from one of several simultaneously updated dependencies.

options.title: Refresh and validate the group
options.body: Rebase or recreate the PR, rerun the failed browser and preview paths, and merge the group only if the exact head passes or the failures are proven unrelated.

options.title: Split runtime updates
options.body: Separate TanStack, Convex, email rendering, and ignore updates so each runtime change has isolated validation and rollback.

options.title: Accept the grouped risk
options.body: Merge the current group after explicitly accepting that the failing runtime checks have not been attributed.

recommendation.title: Refresh and validate the group
recommendation.body: Rebase or recreate the PR, rerun the failed browser and preview paths, and merge the group only if the exact head passes or the failures are proven unrelated.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available history-based routing candidate for package release and dependency workflow decisions, though ownership evidence is limited.
